gates.reason: Issuer, A/H classes, shares, price, currency and Stock Connect status are resolved; full ownership graph is incomplete.
Demand-to-cash chain is understandable, but product-level ASP, effective capacity and customer mix are not fully disclosed.
Q1/H1 margins and profit confirm an inflection; cycle duration and segment purity remain unresolved.
Integration, process capability and global footprint are moat candidates, not a cross-cycle proof.
Placement, overseas expansion and acquisition are visible; diluted per-share outcomes are not.
Cash proxy is reproducible, but maintenance capex and required working capital cannot be separated.
Liquidity is material and near-term survival is not the core issue; net-debt, overseas expansion and covenant details still need monitoring.
P/E sensitivities are reproducible, but owner-earnings value and safety margin are unavailable.
The pack supports monitoring and falsification; formal H1, owner earnings and named human review remain open.

subgates.reason: FY and Q1 TTM are dated; forward cases are sensitivities.
Issuer and global demand signals exist; YOFC orders and ASP are not quantified.
Formal H1 segment data is unavailable.
Technology and expansion are mapped qualitatively.
No three-peer same-scope median or no-look-ahead PE history.
Facts, sensitivities and judgment are kept separate.

pe_denominator_matrix.reason: Reported and sensitivity denominators are dated; adjusted and normalized denominators remain open.

segment_forecast_model.reason: H1 segment revenue and margin are not yet published.

substitution_map.reason: Solid-core, hollow-core, modules and copper/optical interconnect roles are mapped qualitatively.

industry_capacity_cycle.reason: Demand confirmation and announced capacity are both present; timing and effective output are uncertain.

peer_comparables.reason: Hengtong, ZTT, Prysmian and Corning are diversified or cross-market; no decision-grade three-peer median is used.

historical_point_in_time.reason: Price drawdown is dated, but no no-look-ahead historical P/E series is claimed.

low_pe_diagnosis.reason: The apparent forward low P/E is caused by annualizing an exceptional H1 profit alert, not by a settled normalized denominator.
gaps: Formal H1 and H2 order/cash evidence

price_owner_earnings_matrix.reason: Owner earnings is unavailable, so no price-to-owner-earnings claim is made.

investment_return_ledger.reason: Overseas expansion, placement and acquisition are recorded; incremental return has not matured.

price_multiple_attribution.reason: Move reflects fundamental confirmation, supply fear and crowded AI rerating rather than one event.

historical_valuation.reason: Distance from the price high is not a historical valuation percentile.

price_move_attribution.interpretation: Fundamental confirmation, capacity-cycle fear, crowded AI rerating and technical supply zones all matter.

risk_reward_assessment.long_term: The H price is not cheap on reported FY/TTM earnings; it becomes mid-teens only if the H1 run rate persists.
risk_reward_assessment.near_term: Rebound reward to the first supply zone is smaller than downside back to the recent base, so short-window asymmetry is not clearly favorable.
risk_reward_assessment.boundary: Technical reference zones are not intrinsic values or action instructions.

source_gaps: Order, volume, ASP and effective-capacity bridge.
Maintenance capex and required working capital.
Three same-scope peers and no-look-ahead valuation history.

invalidation_tests.invalidated_if: Formal H1 or H2 shows gross-margin normalization without volume/cash offset.
Announced capacity becomes effective faster than demand and ASP weakens.
Computing/data-centre exposure remains qualitative while ordinary fibre drives most earnings.
Inventory, receivables and capex absorb the profit step-up.
invalidation_tests.next_evidence: H1 cash flow and working capital
